title: Garlic Fried Rice
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking and evenly coats the surface.
Add the minced garlic and sauté gently for 1-2 minutes while stirring continuously until it becomes fragrant and lightly golden without burning.
Add the cooked rice and break apart any clumps using a spatula so that the grains separate evenly.
Stir continuously, pressing lightly against the pan to lightly toast the rice and allow it to absorb the garlic flavor.
Season with salt to taste and continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes until the rice is fully heated and slightly crisp, then serve immediately.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a wide pan over medium heat until hot and shimmering.
Crack the eggs directly into the pan and scramble slowly for 1-2 minutes until soft curds form without overcooking.
Add the cooked rice, breaking apart clumps with a spatula to ensure even texture.
Mix thoroughly so the eggs are evenly distributed throughout the rice.
Season with salt and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until fully heated, then serve hot.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat until hot, then add diced chicken and cook for 4-5 minutes until golden brown and fully cooked through.
Add cooked rice and break apart any clumps to ensure even mixing.
Stir continuously to combine the chicken and rice while allowing flavors to blend.
Continue cooking for 2-3 minutes so the rice absorbs the chicken juices slightly.
Season lightly with salt and serve warm.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a wok or pan over medium-high heat until evenly hot.
Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender but still crisp.
Add cooked rice and gently break apart any clumps.
Mix thoroughly while stirring continuously to evenly distribute vegetables.
Season lightly with salt and cook for another 2-3 minutes before serving hot.

title: Pork Rice Bowl
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the sliced pork for 4-5 minutes until browned and fully cooked.
Prepare warm rice in a serving bowl and gently fluff it.
Arrange the cooked pork evenly over the rice, allowing juices to soak into the grains.
Lightly season if needed and let the heat settle for a few seconds.

title: Chicken Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat until hot.
Add sliced chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until nearly done and lightly browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry continuously for 2-3 minutes to ensure even cooking.
Continue cooking until vegetables are slightly tender while retaining crunch and chicken is fully cooked.
Season lightly and serve immediately, preferably with rice.

title: Egg Omelette
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl, add salt, and whisk thoroughly until fully combined.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and pour in the egg mixture, spreading it evenly.
Allow the omelette to cook slowly for 2-3 minutes until the bottom becomes firm and lightly golden.
Carefully flip the omelette and cook the other side for another 1-2 minutes until fully set.

title: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Mix chopped vegetables into beaten eggs until evenly combined.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and pour the mixture evenly across the surface.
Cook gently for 2-3 minutes until the bottom sets firmly.
Flip carefully and cook the other side until fully cooked through.

title: Chicken Rice Simple
steps: Cook chicken in a pan over medium heat for 5-6 minutes until fully tender and evenly browned.
Prepare cooked rice and keep it warm.
Slice or shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Arrange chicken over the rice so the juices enhance the flavor.

title: Vegetable Rice Bowl
steps: Cook rice until soft and fluffy, ensuring proper texture and moisture balance.
Prepare vegetables by sautéing briefly until slightly tender but not overcooked.
Place vegetables over the rice evenly for balanced distribution.
Mix gently or leave layered depending on preference.

title: Egg Rice Bowl
steps: Prepare freshly cooked rice and keep it hot and fluffy in a serving bowl.
Heat oil in a small pan over medium heat and cook the eggs according to preference, either sunny-side up or scrambled.
Allow the eggs to cook for 2-3 minutes until the whites are set and yolks remain slightly soft or fully cooked as desired.
Place the eggs over the hot rice and let the residual heat warm everything evenly.
Lightly break and mix the eggs into the rice just before eating to enhance flavor distribution.

title: Chicken Rice Stir
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat until hot and lightly shimmering.
Add diced chicken and cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and lightly browned.
Add the cooked rice and break apart clumps using a spatula for even texture.
Stir continuously to allow the rice to absorb the chicken juices and flavors.
Season lightly with salt and continue cooking for 2-3 minutes until evenly heated before serving.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat until fully hot and evenly spread.
Add vegetables and stir-fry continuously for 2-3 minutes to prevent burning.
Cook until vegetables become slightly tender while still maintaining a crisp texture.
Season lightly with salt and toss thoroughly for even coating.
Serve immediately while hot for best texture and flavor.

title: Chicken Soup
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot over medium-high heat.
Add chicken pieces and reduce heat to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 20-25 minutes until the chicken becomes tender and the broth develops flavor.
Skim off any impurities that rise to the surface to keep the broth clear.
Season lightly and serve hot as a comforting soup.

title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot over medium heat.
Add chopped vegetables and lower the heat to maintain a gentle simmer.
Cook for 15-20 minutes until vegetables become soft and tender.
Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking throughout.
Season lightly with salt and serve hot.

title: Chicken Vegetable Rice
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook diced chicken for 4-5 minutes until fully cooked and lightly browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp.
Add cooked rice and break apart any clumps using a spatula.
Mix thoroughly while stirring to evenly combine flavors.
Season lightly and cook for another 2-3 minutes before serving hot.

title: Egg and Potato Mix
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and cook diced potatoes for 6-8 minutes until tender and lightly golden on the outside.
Beat eggs in a bowl and pour them over the cooked potatoes.
Stir gently to combine the eggs evenly with the potatoes.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the eggs are fully set.

title: Rice and Meat Plate
steps: Cook the meat thoroughly over medium heat until well browned and tender.
Prepare warm rice and fluff it gently to separate the grains.
Place the meat evenly over the rice so the juices soak into the grains.
Allow the dish to sit for a minute to absorb the flavors.

title: Chicken Vegetable Bowl
steps: Cook chicken until golden brown and fully tender over medium heat.
Prepare vegetables separately until slightly softened but not overcooked.
Place hot rice into a serving bowl and fluff gently.

title: Egg Rice Skillet
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat until hot.

Add the cooked rice and mix thoroughly with the eggs.
Break apart clumps and stir continuously for even cooking.

title: Chicken Garlic Rice
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat until hot and evenly distributed.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes while stirring until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add sliced chicken and cook for 4-5 minutes until fully cooked and slightly browned.
Add cooked rice and break apart clumps using a spatula to ensure even mixing.
Stir thoroughly and cook for another 2-3 minutes until everything is evenly heated, then serve hot.

title: Vegetable Egg Fried Mix
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and cook vegetables for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
Push vegetables to one side and crack the eggs into the pan, scrambling gently until just set.
Add the rice and break apart clumps thoroughly.
Mix all ingredients evenly while stirring continuously.
Season lightly and cook for another 2-3 minutes before serving hot.

title: Chicken Vegetable Rice Bowl
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook diced chicken for 4-5 minutes until browned and fully cooked.
Add vegetables and sauté for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender but still crisp.

title: Pork Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat until hot.

Add vegetables and stir-fry continuously for 2-3 minutes.

title: Egg and Rice Combo Plate

title: Vegetable Rice Saute

title: Chicken Egg Rice Mix
steps: Heat oil in a pan and cook chicken for 4-5 minutes until browned and fully cooked.

title: Vegetable Egg Scramble Bowl

steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat until hot and lightly shimmering.

title: Garlic Chicken Rice
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté minced garlic for 1-2 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden.

title: Fish Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup fish fillet, cooked and flaked
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat until hot and lightly shimmering.
Add the flaked fish and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring gently to warm and lightly crisp the edges.
Add cooked rice and break apart clumps using a spatula to ensure even texture.
Stir thoroughly to combine fish evenly throughout the rice while allowing flavors to blend.
Season lightly with salt and cook for another 2-3 minutes until fully heated, then serve hot.

title: Shrimp Garlic Rice

title: Tuna Rice Bowl

title: Fish Vegetable Stir Fry

title: Shrimp Vegetable Stir Fry

Add cooked rice to the pan and break apart clumps.
Return seafood to the pan and mix thoroughly to combine all ingredients.

title: Chicken Shrimp Rice Bowl

title: Squid Fried Rice
